help:
Bagaev authored-record commands
check                  Pinned source-only semantic check
run                    Explicit reference execution; separate authority required
inspect                Data-only inspection; form5 default, explicit --form 6
function               Extract/context/replace; replacement produces a draft packet
draft                  Restricted multi-body draft packet; not applied source
export                 Validate and export a draft packet to fresh source
compile-cpython        Checked form5/profile11 artifact; no generated execution
run-cpython            Fresh checked source run; separately reviewed Python pin required
verify-cpython-run     Retained CPython consistency; no execution or authentication
verify-cpython-run-expectation  Compare retained CPython data with pinned expectations
history                Portable form5/form6 revision packages
history-store          Local candidate history storage; not admission
verify-run             Retained source-run consistency
verify-run-expectation Compare one retained run with supplied expectations
verify-expectation-set Compare a complete supplied obligation set
check-location         Bound checker refusal to explicit form5/form6 source
failure-location       Bound retained runtime failure to pinned source
format                 Token-preserving source formatting
diagnose               Source syntax diagnostics
source-map             Explicit source/program-bound locations
Pass the remaining arguments unchanged to the documented delegate.
Use Python -B -S with assertions and an authorized execution profile.
Drafts, artifacts, hashes and consistency checks grant no execution authority.
invocation: One command per fresh -B -S process; never reuse reader imports for compilation.
